newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close lower, Astra leads losses.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close lower, Astra leads losses.

text.p: Sweden's sharemarket closed lower on Wednesday with drugs heavyweight Astra leading the losses while buyers were sidelined at high levels.
The Stockholm general index fell 0.62 percent to 2,030.81, slipping away from last Friday's all-time high for the third consecutive day. Shares worth 2.8 billion crowns were traded.
Brokers said the market needed a period of consolidation after the sharp gains of last week.
"The market's taken a pause amid a lot of uncertainty," one broker said. "We have Sweden's budget on Friday and the Fed meeting next week, but before that it will be quiet."

The drugs sector index tumbled 1.13 percent, depressed by Astra which closed 3.50 crowns lower at 277.50 crowns. Brokers said the Swedish drug authority's approval for the parallel imports of Astra's drug Losec was still weighing on the stock.
Fellow bluechip Ericsson slipped 0.50 crown to 165.50.
A winner during the day was car safety equipment maker Autoliv that jumped 7.50 crowns to close at 240.50 crowns with interest in the stock fuelled by a U.S. report on car safety equipment.
